name: Gyomaendrőd (Hungary)
description: A vertical blue banner charged near the top with the town arms of Gyomaendrőd: a red shield with a white heart, a fish and a plough, inscribed GYOMAENDRŐD on the chief.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
